text:
alex_h: Quick sync — need a decision on Q3 capacity plan. Do we prioritize a bulk GPU PO for NA/EU, or lean into region expansion (APAC) with smaller spot pools? ask: procurement lead times, customer SLAs, OKR targets (util %), cost delta.
maria_g: Customers in fintech + health are pushing for lower-latency APAC nodes. Two enterprise deals may require front-door presence in SG by end of Q4.
jasper: Current fleet: avg 72% utilization across committed pools, but hotspots in us-west at 92% during peak. If we push more reserved A100 into us-west we hit SLA headroom with minimal infra changes.
priya_r: Tradeoff: buying 120 A100s (NA/EU) vs buying 48 H100s + 40 A100s for APAC entry. Lead time: A100s ~10-12 weeks, H100s ~14-18 weeks. Budget delta: ~+55% for mixed H100 purchase.
sam_ops: Question — what's the target utilization we need to hit OKR? current SLO is p95 latency 120ms; dropping below that triggers support alerts. Also need a headroom buffer for canary / rollouts.
maria_g: From product/CS side: OKR target = stable regional latency + <2% error budget burn. We want utilization target 80-85% on committed pools to keep cost efficient but allow bursts.
jasper: Proposal A: Aggressive commit for Q3 — 120 A100 split 60/60 (us-east/eu-west). Pros: fixes peak hotspots, best $/token. Cons: APAC customers wait.
priya_r: Proposal B: Hybrid APAC-first — 48 H100 + 40 A100 placed in ap-southeast + us-west. Pros: buys APAC presence & perf. Cons: higher capex, longer lead time.
alex_h: Can we defer some backlog features or use dedicated burst windows for APAC instead of full PO? That would buy time until H100 lead times shorten.
engops-bot: fleet-snapshot: avg_util=72%, us-west_peak=92%, us-east_peak=78%, eu-west_peak=69%, apac_avg=0%
jasper: Short tactical move: shift 20 A100 from low-util eu pool to us-west for 6 weeks, enable cross-region routing, then re-evaluate. That avoids immediate PO.
priya_r: Risk: moving capacity impacts eu SLAs for a handful of customers. We can mitigate with traffic shaping + cache warmup windows.
maria_g: Customer impact note — two APAC deals need a prod presence by Nov. If we go tactical shift, we must commit to an APAC PO in Q4.
sam_ops: If leadership ok with a two-phased approach, we should submit a smaller Q3 PO for 48 A100 (reserve) to shorten lead time, and queue a Q4 APAC H100 PO. That gives us runway.
alex_h: Sounds reasonable. Action items: 1) sam_ops to prepare small Q3 PO estimate + cost delta (due 3 days). 2) jasper to write routing change plan and carryover risks (2 days). 3) priya to draft customer communication and Q4 APAC commitment note (EOD Fri).
:memo:alex_h: Tentative decision: approve two-step plan — tactical shift + small reserved Q3 PO, APAC H100 commit in Q4 contingent on deal closures.
junior-dev:thumbsup:: +1
engops-bot: docket: created ticket INFRA-6217 for Q3 PO estimate and INFRA-6218 for routing plan.
